them.zh: Bright Data 包与 CLI 做的

steps.en: Install the Bright Data CLI and approve the login in your browser
steps.zh: 装好 Bright Data CLI，在浏览器里批准登录

steps.en: Stores the API key locally and creates two billed zones on your account
steps.zh: 把 API 密钥存到本地，在你账上建好两个计费 zone

steps.en: Install the skills you want into the agent, one at a time
steps.zh: 把需要的 skill 逐个装进 agent

steps.en: Ask the agent in plain words for a page, a search, or records from a site
steps.zh: 用大白话让 agent 取一个页面、一次搜索或某个站点的记录

steps.en: Routes the job to search, page fetch, a per-site extractor or the cloud browser, and runs the call
steps.zh: 把活分给搜索、单页抓取、按站点提取器或云端浏览器，并发出调用

steps.en: Greps the result for block-page signatures before reporting success; each call is billed
steps.zh: 汇报成功前先 grep 封锁页特征；每次调用都计费

value.en: The agent brings back the real page or record instead of a 403 or challenge page; you pay per request instead of running browsers and proxies
value.zh: agent 带回真页面或真记录，而不是 403 或验证页；你按次付费，不用自己运维浏览器和代理

sources: README.md Agent Onboarding Skill / How it works: `curl -fsSL https://cli.brightdata.com/install.sh | bash`, `npm install -g @brightdata/cli`, `bdata login`; 'saves the API key locally, auto-creates the cli_unlocker and cli_browser zones'
skills/agent-onboarding/SKILL.md Install + path routing (A/B/M/C/D) and the `bdata skill add scrape` lines
skills/scrape/SKILL.md 'Not a block page' check (Access Denied, Just a moment, Attention Required, Checking your browser, captcha)
skills/bright-data-mcp/SKILL.md BEST/GOOD/WORST tool choice for an Amazon product; skills/data-feeds/SKILL.md `bdata pipelines <type> <url>`
brightdata/cli src/commands/skill-add.ts: fetches skill folders via GitHub contents API at ref=main
